$description: BIM AMENITY KEY PLANS token category — non-leasable building service and amenity spaces for Professional Centre and Suburban Office development classes. Includes building core amenities (Tenant Lounge, Lobby Atrium, Building Manager, Mail Room, Elevator Lobby, Restrooms, Loading, Recycling, Bike Room, Workbench, Lockers, Coffee/Bread, Public Restrooms, Mop Room) and general-type utility spaces (Corridor Expanders, Meter Room). Areas sourced from Spatial Taxonomy — Key Plans and Tiles — Professional Centres and Suburban Office (AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf, Collaborators #11, 2025-01-07). All spaces are non-leasable; they form the building core component of the 13% core factor. IFC anchor: IfcSpace for occupied rooms; IfcTransportElement for circulation elements.

general.$description: General-type utility Key Plans present across all development classes (Professional Centre and Suburban Office). Not tied to a specific development class.

$value.source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.4 — R 50 SF
$value.description: Small corridor-widening segment used at junctions and corners in the upper-floor circulation system. 50 SF. Placed at elevator lobbies, stairwell landings, and demising-wall offsets where the standard Tile corridor is insufficient for accessible turning radii.
$value.tile_role: circulation — non-leasable; part of building core allocation

corridor-expanders.$description: Corridor Expanders R-1. 50 SF (4.6 m²). General-type upper-floor circulation segment.

$value.source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.4 — V 150 SF
$value.description: Electrical meter room housing tenant submetering equipment. 150 SF. Located on each floor; accessed from core corridor. Contains sub-metering panels for each Tile climate zone to enable direct tenant thermostat control.

meter-room.$description: Meter Room V-1. 150 SF (13.9 m²). Electrical sub-metering room per floor. General-type.

professional-centre.$description: Amenity and service Key Plans specific to Professional Centre development class (3–5 stories, 19,000–23,000 SF gross floor plate).
